entries.question: Can ClaimFact, ExecutionAuthorityFact, and EffectReservationFact safely collapse to Claim + Attempt while actually reducing machinery and preserving performance?

Both smaller single-clock variants fail: rotating the clock admits a successor while the prior external mutation remains unresolved; preserving it fails to fence stale authority.

Only the controlled sandbox satisfies either an absence-through-execution guarantee or controlled physical isolation.
